title: Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams is now generally available
body: The Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams is now [generally available](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Chat with the app in a direct message or mention `@Databricks Genie` in a channel or group chat to get answers to data questions without leaving Microsoft Teams. See [Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams](/aws/en/integrations/msft-teams).

ref_links.text: Databricks Genie app in Microsoft Teams
